basic_info.description: Alice had to fall down a rabbit hole before she got to her magical garden. The path to your storybook setting takes you behind a two-flat building where a cottage condo is surrounded by trees and flowers. Inside, golden softwood floors and tall ceilings welcome you into a well laid-out floor plan with living area to the left and kitchen/dining to the right. This is the kind of place for a party   where five people can cook all at the same time in a kitchen with enough space to keep everything from your crock pot to air fryer tucked away. The adjacent living room has a cozy corner where you can kick back with a book or watch TV. There's also a half bath down a short passage with a coat closet along the way. Upstairs, a large landing with a recessed laundry area gives way to two bedrooms and a full bath with radiant heated floors. Deep closet space offers excellent storage, with more room in the garage for bicycles, kayaks and other assorted toys. This is also a "leave your car at home" location on a flat block with light rail just out front, two coffee shops withing 200 yards and Whole Foods just six blocks away. When you do drive, there's swift access to freeways for easy commutes South or an escape into the Bay Area's natural beauty
